requirement.summary: HTNG PMS interface - Unable to use same echo token in retry void posting after no response in PMS interface
requirement.description:
It is appeared in HTNG PMS interface

System is unable to reuse echo token in retry void posting after no response in PMS interface

Setup:

1. Turn on partial payment features

* Location: POS System > Ordering Setup > Config by Location

* Setup name: Support Partial Payment

> Sub-setting name: Support Partial Payment

>> Setting value as "Yes"

> Sub-setting name: Print Receipt Only When Finish All Payment

>> Setting value as "Yes"

2. Setting to use new echo token checking rules

* Location: Interface Control > Interfaces

* Vendor: HTNG PMS interface

* Setup name: Apply New EchoToken Checking Rule

> Setting value as "Yes"

Workflow:

1. Click button "Admin"

2. Select tab "Check Operation"

3. Click function "Check Listing"

4. Select tab "Paid Check Listing"

5. Select a check settled with HTNG PMS interface

6. Select receipt print format

7. Click function "Release Payment"

8. Click "Confirm" button

9. Select void reason

10. System triggers external part API for void posting

11. External party no response

12. System fails to save the retry packet

13. Repeat step 1-10

14. System using new echo token and trigger external party API

Expected result:

- System able to save the retry detail in extra info and reuse the echo token in retry PMS void posting
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-68390] HTNG PMS interface - Unable to use same echo token in retry void posting after no response in PMS interface (Teresa)
Descriptions:
It is available for HTNG PMS interface, type Shiji, Shiji Template 1 and ShijiConnect+
After receiving timeout or error from void posting, system:
fails to save the original posting packet for later retry and reuse of echo token if the packet itself has string length shorter than 65535
wrongly saves the same value under multiple retry packet indices if the packet itself has string length longer than 65535
Workflow
1. Click button "Admin"
2. Select tab "Check Operation"
3. Click function "Check Listing"
4. Select tab "Paid Check Listing"
5. Select a check settled with HTNG PMS interface
6. Select receipt print format
7. Click function "Release Payment"
8. Click "Confirm" button
9. Select void reason
10. System triggers external part API for void posting
11. External party returns no response or error
12. System fails to save the retry packet
13. Repeat step 1-10
14. System using new echo token and trigger external party API
Expected result:
System able to save the retry detail in extra info and reuse the echo token in subsequent retry PMS void posting
If the retry packet is too long, the system will gather all cropped parts to form a complete retry detail for void posting
It is fixed in current version
Setup:
For detailed setup of HTNG PMS interface, please refer to
Infrasys Cloud POS - HTNG (Shiji Type) PMS Setup and Workflow Document v1.0.0.21

The room number also needs to be displayed for the HTGN PMS room charge payment method. In addition, the POS045 report migration requires this data to be pushed to SDP.

The existing SDP data transfer interface transfers a limited set of data sets and does not include pos_check_print_logs, pos_interface_configs, pos_access_rights, pos_access_right_acls, pos_config and pos_access_right_group_lookup.

requirement.summary: Reservation Edit Floor Plan - AJAX reload fails when switching outlet / period / floor plan
requirement.description:
Use Case

Edit Floor Plan under Reservation Operation. When the user changes Outlet, Period, or Floor Plan from the dropdowns at the top of the page, the system reloads the floor plan HTML fragment via AJAX.

Steps to Reproduce

- Log in to Reservation Operation and open Edit Floor Plan.

- Select a valid Outlet, Period, and Floor Plan; confirm the floor plan renders correctly.

- Change Outlet, Period, or Floor Plan (repeat 2–3 times if needed).

- Observe the page and the browser console (F12).

Current Result (before fix)

- After switching, the floor plan may fail to load or behave incorrectly.

- The browser console may show JavaScript errors, e.g. top-level const / let redeclaration (Identifier '…' has already been declared).

- Document-level PBG / Table Module change handlers may bind more than once, causing duplicate checkbox behaviour.

- When AJAX loads floor_plan_view, some PHP variables were not passed in, which can trigger undefined variable notices on PHP 8+.

- jQuery UI widgets (draggable / resizable / dialog) and window resize listeners may not be torn down before reload, leading to leaks or duplicate behaviour.

Expected Result

- Outlet / Period / Floor Plan can be switched multiple times; the floor plan reloads correctly each time.

- No JavaScript console errors.

- No duplicate event handlers or leftover widgets.

- HKJC Table Module / Export UI is not shown in Reservation when module data is not loaded (incomplete UI avoided).

Root Cause

- Incomplete reload lifecycle in edit_floor_plan.ctp: New HTML was injected without clearing old DOM, jQuery handlers, or jQuery UI widgets. Inline scripts in floor_plan_view.ctp used top-level const / let, which throw on re-execution.

- Event leakage: PBG-related $(document).on('change', …) in floor_plan_view.ctp were not namespaced; handlers from the previous load were not removed.

- Missing backend/view variables: load_edit_floor_plan did not pass outTableModuleInfos, exportTableFields, or bSupportHkjc into the floor_plan_view element, and the controller did not set them explicitly.

- Outlet-side fix (incidental): FloorPlanTablesController::__updateTableModuleInfo() ignored its $tableModuleInfos argument and read $this->data['TableModuleInfo'] directly; admin_add could hit an undefined index when TableModuleInfo was absent from POST.
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-69271] Reservation Edit Floor Plan – AJAX reload fails when switching outlet/period/floor plan
Description:
Edit Floor Plan under Reservation Operation. When the user changes Outlet, Period, or Floor Plan from the dropdowns at the top of the page, the system reloads the floor plan HTML fragment via AJAX.
Setup:
Reservation Operation: navigate to [Edit Floor Plan] page.
Change Outlet, Period, or Floor Plan.

requirement.summary: [Tech] TMS 2.0 - Rename TMS direct-delete housekeeping to TmsDataPurgeHousekeepingComponent
requirement.description:
User story:

Platform archive housekeeping discovers a class named exactly after the plugin plus HousekeepingComponent, and that class must extend SysHousekeepingBaseComponent. TMS already had TmsHousekeepingComponent, which extends TmsCollectionComponent and hard-deletes tms_table_states, tms_messages, and empty pos_outlet_tables in obsoleteDataPurge(). HousekeepingShell loaded that class and called that method.

Issue:-

Keeping that class name blocks the archive component. If the same class is later changed to extend SysHousekeepingBaseComponent while cake Housekeeping -p Tms is still scheduled, the old job runs the new copy-verify-purge flow.

What changed:

- Plugin/Tms/Controller/Component/TmsHousekeepingComponent.php is renamed to TmsDataPurgeHousekeepingComponent.php. The class is TmsDataPurgeHousekeepingComponent. obsoleteDataPurge() is unchanged.

- HousekeepingShell.__callPluginComponent() loads PluginName + DataPurgeHousekeeping instead of PluginName + Housekeeping.

After the change:

cake Housekeeping -p Tms still direct-deletes those tables. TmsHousekeepingComponent is free for the archive component that extends SysHousekeepingBaseComponent. A plugin with no DataPurgeHousekeeping component is skipped.

requirement.summary: TMS 2.0 - Online booking fails with "Fail to update segment allotment" when outlet requires payment and Period Segment Allotment is configured
requirement.description:
Online reservation user completes a booking on an outlet that has both Payment enabled and Period Segment Allotment configured. After submitting the booking form, the guest should be redirected to the payment page. Pre-order flow with segment allotment works; payment flow does not.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Go to Config by Date page, edit a period, add settings for "Payment Settings" and "Period Segment Allotment" and save.

2. Go to Online Reservation page, fill in the reservation information and guest information, then click the save button.

Actual result:

Booking does not continue to the payment page. An error is shown: "Fail to update segment allotment". [Unexpected]

Expected result:

Guest proceeds to payment. Segment quota is reserved on submit and associated with the confirmed booking after payment, without double deduction.
requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [Jira-68960] - TMS 2.0 - Online booking fails with "Fail to update segment allotment" when outlet requires payment and Period Segment Allotment is configured
Description:
Fixed online booking failure with "Fail to update segment allotment" when payment is required and Period Segment Allotment is configured.
Setup:
Go to Table Management System > Basic Setup > Config by Date page, add payment settings for the current time period.
Simultaneously switch to the "Period Segment Allotment" tab and add the "Period Segment Allotment (Online)" setting.
Go to the outlet during this time period.
